SELECT a.*, a.applicant_name, a.applicant_phone, a.applicant_occupation, a.applicant_address, a.applicant_experience, u.real_name, u.phone, p.pet_name, b.breed_name, p.pet_photo, p.adopt_status, ad.admin_name FROM adopt_apply a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN pet_breed b ON p.breed_id = b.breed_id LEFT JOIN admin ad ON a.audit_admin = ad.admin_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.audit_status = #{auditStatus}
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC
